Notes:
(2005 - 2007) (as Ace)
At Your Own Risk is another one of Tyler's earliest projects that was set to release on MySpace in 2008, containing a lot of reworked beats from Dreams In 3-D. This was mainly an instrumental album, with the only songs actually having vocals being Get Fresh, Speakerboxx & Sorry.... This project was likely shelved in favor of Stereo-Type sometime in early 2007, but was later worked on later that year. Tyler ended up making a final instrumental copy of this album in 2008 that he burned onto CD's and gave to friends. Although he is never known to have recorded on this copy, the instrumental copy is known to be had.

The only official release from this album was Potato Salad, with it being considered scrapped in early 2019 after Tyler stated “i wish rocky would shut the fuck up and stop always saying what he's working on 40 years before its even a fleshed out idea.” and “that shit dont exist yall =)” in reference to WANG$AP. Tyler later revealed in 2025 that him and Rocky as a duo were originally meant to be called "DON'T TAP THE GLASS", a phrase which he would eventually reuse as the name of his ninth studio album.

Name:
CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST
(Hosted by DJ Drama)
(CALL ME WHEN YOU GET LOST)
Notes:
(2019 - 2021) (2023) (as Tyler, The Creator)
CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST is Tyler's seventh studio album, released on June 25, 2021. Originally, CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST would've been a mixtape where he would rap over other people's beats, but he would later scrap this idea. This idea can be seen mostly with the throwaways in this era, but also in some songs on the album such as LUMBERJACK & SIR BAUDELAIRE. Tyler mentions in an interview that he started the album on December 25th, 2019 and initially thought the album was done in November 2020, but he would later rework the project into what we have right now. Tyler later rereleased this album as "CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST: The Estate Sale" on March 31, 2023.

CHROMAKOPIA is Tyler's eighth studio album, released on October 28th, 2024. This album is the first album by Tyler, The Creator to break many of his "traditions" when it comes to releasing albums: he broke his 2 year rule (a rule where he only drops an album every two years, The Estate Sale dropped just last year) & his 10th track rule (when there are two or three tracks in one track, specifically on the 10th track of the album). Name: DON'T TAP THE GLASS
Notes:
(2024 - 2025) (as Tyler, The Creator)
DON'T TAP THE GLASS is Tyler's ninth studio album, released on July 21st, 2025. This project started on December 31st, 2024 and all of the verses were recorded in May 2025 during the CHROMAKOPIA tour. It was first teased on July 16th with a photo of him with a trumpet in a marching band outfit, this is where fans got the idea that this was either for the Sticky music video that was teased months prior or a CHROMAKOPIA deluxe. On July 18th, the album's physicals were released on the Golf Wang store, which is how the fans got their first taste of the album.
